full.description: This is a micrograph showing a histological section of tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The section displays cellular nests or islands of epithelial cells exhibiting a prominent peripheral palisading arrangement. The nests are surrounded by a fibrous stroma. These architectural features are characteristic of basal cell carcinoma.

random.description: This is a high-magnification micrograph stained with H&E showing lung tissue. The image displays non-caseating granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. The findings are characteristic of pulmonary sarcoidosis.
captions: Sarcoidosis. Sarcoid granulomas surrounded by dense, brightly eosinophilic lamellar collagen. Note the rosette-like adventitial distribution in this example. The central structure in this image is a pulmonary artery. H&E stain, 40xoriginal magnification.
